newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EUREKO INSURANCE ALLIANCE SEEKS NEW MEMBERS.
newsitem.headline: EUREKO INSURANCE ALLIANCE SEEKS NEW MEMBERS.

text.p: Eureko, an alliance of six European financial services companies, said on Friday it was holding talks with a view to adding two new members.
"We are in talks with candidates in France and Italy," said Gijs Swalef chairman of Dutch Eureko member Achmea said.
But Swalef added that the talks might take quite some time before they came to a final conclusion.
Earlier today, Achmea announced that 1996 net profit rose 21.5 percent to 572 million guilders.
Eureko was established in 1992 and unlisted Achmea has been involved from the very beginning.
The other five members are Britain's Friends Provident, German Gothaer Versicherungen, Sweden's Wasa and listed Topdanmark and BCP of Portugal.
Swalef told reporters he expected Eureko's turnover to rise by 10 to 15 billion guilders or more by 2000, from some 35 billion guilders at present.
"Our group should have a maximum of eight members," Swalef said, adding that a greater number would make it difficult for the group to make decisions.
"Decisions are based on the consensus-principle," he said.
Swalef did not rule out a further integration of Eureko-members, but added that there were no direct plans for further integration just yet.
He said Eureko was not yet thinking of a bourse listing for the whole group but he did not rule out such a move in the future.
"If we make a big acquisition we might need an extra source of finance," he said.
Currently all six partners have a stake in Eureko, which in turn holds a stake in each of the six partners.
